definition: Techniques that stretch or reshape RoPE frequencies so a model trained on short contexts can operate at much longer contexts with little or no additional training.
details: Techniques that stretch or reshape RoPE frequencies so a model trained on short contexts can operate at much longer contexts with little or no additional training. How many "128k context" models are actually made.

explainer.lead: RoPE scaling stretches or reshapes RoPE frequencies so a model trained on short contexts can operate at much longer contexts with little or no extra training. It matters because this is how many '128k context' models are actually made.

tiers.eli5: It's like adjusting a ruler's markings so the same ruler can measure a much longer room without buying a new one.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers apply frequency stretching or reshaping to extend context length cheaply instead of retraining from scratch. A pitfall is expecting extended context to perform as well as a model trained natively at that length.
tiers.paperLevel: These are techniques that stretch or reshape RoPE frequencies so a model trained on short contexts can operate at much longer contexts with little or no additional training.

explainer.example: A model trained on short sequences is rescaled with RoPE scaling and advertised as supporting 128k-token context.
